description: This file manages unhandled promise rejections, categorizing errors (fatal, configuration, transient), and installing a global handler for unhandled rejections with specific logic for different error types.

methods.name: hasSqliteSignal
methods.description: Checks if an error is related to SQLite signals based on error code, name, or message.

methods.name: isWrappedFetchFailedMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message indicates a wrapped fetch failure.

methods.name: getErrorCause
methods.description: Retrieves the cause of an error if available.

methods.name: extractErrorCodeOrErrno
methods.description: Extracts a normalized error code or errno from an error object.

methods.name: extractNumericErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts a numeric error code from an error object based on a specified key.

methods.name: extractErrorCodeWithCause
methods.description: Extracts error code considering the error and its cause chain.
